note.en: Train the chest on more than one day a week, keep every repetition under control, and add load in small steps only once the movement feels easy.
note.zh: 胸部每周练不止一天；每一次都要有控制；动作变得轻松后，再小步加重。

title.en: One way to arrange a chest session (an example, not a prescription)
title.zh: 一种胸部训练课的安排（示例，不是处方）

note.en: Warm up with an easy version, hands raised if needed.
note.zh: 先做容易的版本热身，需要时把手撑高。

note.en: The main lift, with safety bars or a spotter; build up from the empty bar.
note.zh: 主项，用保护杠或请人保护；从空杠逐步加重。

note.en: A low incline for the upper part of the muscle.
note.zh: 低角度上斜，照顾胸大肌上部。

note.en: Lighter, slower work through a comfortable range.
note.zh: 较轻、较慢，在舒服的幅度里做。

note.en: Finish with the shoulder blades: slow and without shrugging.
note.zh: 最后练肩胛骨：慢，不耸肩。

note.en: Big multi-joint lifts come first while you are fresh; lighter single-joint work comes later. Leave a day or more before training the chest hard again.
note.zh: 精力最好时先做多关节的大动作，后面再做较轻的单关节动作。胸部练得很累之后，至少隔一天再练。
